cardEffects:
[Security] [All Turns] All of your [Royal Base] trait Digimon get +1000 DP.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your other Digimon with the [Royal Base] trait would leave the battle area by effects, by placing this Digimon as the face-up bottom security card, they don't leave.
name: ForgeBeemon

rulings.answer: Yes, all of those Digimon are prevented from leaving.  This card's [All Turns] effect affects all Digimon without having to choose them.
rulings.question: If I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when multiples of my other Digimon with the [Royal Base] trait would leave the battle area at the same time by effects, are all of those Digimon prevented from leaving?

rulings.answer: BT19-053 [QueenBeemon]'s [All Turns] effect places all of your Digimon with the [Royal Base] trait into your security stack.  In such cases, this card's [All Turns] effect prevents all of your Digimon with the [Royal Base] trait from being deleted, but if BT19-053 [QueenBeemon]'s [All Turns] effect activates afterward, you can place all of your [Royal Base] trait Digimon that were affected by the deletion effect into your security stack.
rulings.question: I have this card, BT19-053 [QueenBeemon], and another Digimon with the [Royal Base] trait in my battle area.  My opponent uses BT5-110 [All Delete] and I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when multiples of my other Digimon would leave the battle area at the same time, and all of my other Digimon with the [Royal Base] trait are prevented from leaving. What happens if BT19-053 [QueenBeemon]'s [All Turns] effect activates afterward?

rulings.answer: They become face-up security cards that remain revealed.  Other than rules that specify face-up security cards, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security cards.
rulings.question: What happens to cards placed face up in the security stack by effects?

rulings.answer: The check is performed with the card left revealed.  Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security checks.
rulings.question: What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check with that card placed face-up?

rulings.answer: Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards.  After shuffling, all cards are left face-down.
rulings.question: What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?
